subject: SIG / CAIQ: customer-specific log-retention & deletion exception request
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@oxbridge.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@oxbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Clarification on log retention / SIG answers (customer-specific exception)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the SIG questionnaire draft you shared during the review. A couple of follow-ups from our side on retention/deletion so we can close this out for our internal auditors: 

1) Oxbridge has a contractual need to retain certain request-level logs for 180 days for a small subset of EU tenants processing regulated telemetry. Your SOC 2 narrative and CAIQ map to a default 90-day ephemeral log TTL. We need to understand whether Redwood can:
   - make a tenant-scoped retention exception for these tenants (180d)
   - provide evidence of deletion when the window expires (deletion proof/audit log)

2) Forensic exports: what is the exact process and artifacts you provide if we request a historic sample of logs for an investigation after retention has lapsed?

3) Encryption/KMS: will logs retained beyond the default window remain encrypted under customer KMS keys (we're a Private deployment candidate)?

We've attached a short spreadsheet (oxbridge_sig_questions.xlsx) with the specific SIG/C A I Q rows where we need clarifications. For timeline, our auditors want final responses and evidence by next Wednesday (2026-10-07). Is that feasible?

Appreciate your help — please loop in whoever owns retention/forensics at Redwood.

Best,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Security & Compliance
Oxbridge Analytics
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@oxbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Clarification on log retention / SIG answers (customer-specific exception)

Sam —

Thanks for the clear list and for attaching the row-level mapping. Quick notes up front: we can support a tenant-scoped retention extension to 180 days, but it requires a formal exception and one-time operational steps to ensure deletion proofing and isolation. I want to outline what we will deliver and what we'll need from Oxbridge to make it auditable.

Deliverables from Redwood (if approved):
- A signed exception letter (we'll draft) that records the tenant IDs and retention window.
- Daily audit records showing TTL changes and deletion job runs for affected tenants (CSV export) for the exception period.
- A retained-forensics export procedure: we will provide a time-bound export (logs partitioned by tenant) and an MD5 manifest and signed assertion of deletion when the retention expires.
- If on Private (customer-managed KMS): logs are encrypted with the customer KMS key; otherwise we keep them encrypted with customer-specific envelope keys.

We will need from Oxbridge:
- List of tenant ids in scope and the associated legal justification or contract clause (to attach to the exception).
- The desired evidence format (CSV vs Parquet) and whether you need a notarized signature / DocuSign.

Next steps: Marissa — can you confirm the technical feasibility for the export/manifest and estimate how long to produce a sample deletion-proof artifact? Rishi — we'll need your ok to route this through the exceptions workflow (security + legal signoff).

Sam — I'll attach our retention matrix (redwood_retention_matrix_v2.pdf) and a short draft exception template in a follow-up.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:29:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Clarification on log retention / SIG answers (customer-specific exception)

Jonas / Marissa —

Echoing Jonas' note. Operational items from my side (commercial/contract):
- We can approve a 180-day tenant-scoped retention exception for Oxbridge as part of a patch to the SOW. I'll draft amendment language referencing the tenant IDs.
- Pricing: extended retention increases storage and forensics support costs. I propose a one-time onboarding fee + monthly incremental charge for extended retention. I'll include a stub in the amendment.

Marissa — can you confirm the effort to produce: (a) a one-off sample deletion-proof artifact for a single tenant (b) the automation story we can offer if Oxbridge wants this for >5 tenants? Please include timelines (days).

Laura — looped for legal signoff workflow; we will need redline approval and a signed acknowledgement that Oxbridge accepts the compensating controls (access audit, retention manifest, encryption details).

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@oxbridge.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 16:38:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Clarification on log retention / SIG answers (customer-specific exception)

Sam —

Following internal review with Legal and Security, we're prepared to approve a scoped 180-day tenant retention exception for the Oxbridge tenants you identify, subject to the controls below. We've attached the signed exception acknowledgement (signed-exception-acknowledgement.pdf) and a short checklist for auditability.

Required controls and commitments:
- Tenant list: Oxbridge to provide canonical tenant IDs and the SOW amendment reference within 5 business days.
- Evidence artifacts: Redwood will provide a sample deletion-proof export (CSV + MD5 manifest + timestamped audit log) within 7 business days of receiving tenant IDs.
- Deletion assurance: upon expiry of the 180-day window we will run the deletion job and produce a deletion manifest with a signed assertion (SHA256) and store the manifest in an immutable evidence bucket.
- Encryption: For Private deployments we will use customer-managed KMS keys; for hosted customers we will use customer-specific envelope keys with HSM-backed master keys.
- Monitoring: Access to retained logs will be restricted and we will provide an audit trail for any access during the extended retention period.

Operational notes:
- For <5 tenants we will run a manual onboarding (one-off fee). For >5 tenants we recommend the automated retention policy task which takes ~3 weeks to configure and test.
- Pricing and amendment language will be provided by Rishi; legal will require a signed exhibit listing the tenant IDs.

Sam, if that aligns, please send the tenant IDs and your preferred evidence format (CSV or Parquet). We'll generate the sample artifact and the amendment draft and route for signature (DocuSign).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
